mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_outbox (producer, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, topic, routing_key, payload, tenant_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{producer}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{topic}, #{routingKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{tenantId}, 'pending', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, producer, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, topic, routing_key AS routingKey, payload::text AS payload, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, created_at AS createdAt, sent_at AS sentAt FROM event_outbox WHERE producer = #{producer} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'sent', sent_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'failed' WHERE id = #{id}
